findings.title: Docker deployments run the gateway with seccomp=unconfined and apparmor=unconfined so the verifier can create namespaces and mount inside them
findings.mitigation: Container still runs as an unprivileged user; prefer the systemd profile on hosts that allow unprivileged user namespaces.

findings.title: Without NAFS_AUTH_TOKENS the API is unauthenticated (loopback only)
findings.mitigation: The gateway refuses non-loopback binds without tokens (ST-25); same-origin and Host checks block browser-based attacks (ST-01..03).

findings.title: The sandbox on macOS relies on sandbox-exec, which Apple marks deprecated
findings.mitigation: Escape tests run in CI and in this review; Linux uses user, network, mount and PID namespaces, a seccomp filter and rlimits, and the same escape tests run there.

findings.title: Sandboxed code could signal (kill) the gateway and other processes of the same user
findings.mitigation: Found by ST-19 on 2026-10-18 (it killed the gateway). macOS profile now denies signals except to the process itself; Linux adds a PID namespace and a fresh /proc (unshare -p --fork --kill-child). Regression test in nafs-verify.
